## Featured Learning Path

::: bms-card
### Demystifying the Doubling Cube

The first learning path explains why cube decisions work, what the cube is asking, and how to think about take points before you memorize exceptions.

- Start with the cube.
- Add gammon value.
- Layer on volatility and timing.
- Bring match score in later.

[Open the learning path](learn/cube/index.qmd){.bms-button-primary}
:::
